creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`SplitRatioSender` (divider drags) and `FindSender` (find keystrokes) each implement the same shape independently: one request in flight, the latest input remembered, and the last one always sent. Both exist because the same problem showed up twice - a per-event round trip over a forwarded socket is tens of milliseconds a keystroke.

They were left apart deliberately rather than by oversight. The find work would have had to widen into a file another parallel slot was editing, and the two are not actually identical: `FindSender` carries an answer back to draw, `SplitRatioSender` has nothing to return. That difference is the design question a shared version has to answer.

Worth lifting when a third one appears - three examples say what the shape really is, where two can only be guessed at.
title: ♻️ Two senders keep one request in flight, and share no code
